capabilities.title: Artifact Lifecycle Manager
capabilities.purpose: Classify artifacts as source, evidence, generated, cache, temporary, archive, or quarantine and manage each accordingly.
capabilities.invariant: Unknown artifacts are preserved until classified; generated artifacts never masquerade as canonical source.

capabilities.title: Assumption Auditor
capabilities.purpose: Extract, classify, and test assumptions embedded in plans, code changes, diagnostics, and agent reasoning.
capabilities.invariant: Assumptions must never be silently promoted to facts.

capabilities.title: Audit Event Ledger
capabilities.purpose: Provide an append-only event history connecting requests, agents, tools, decisions, changes, validations, and outcomes.
capabilities.invariant: Every material state transition is attributable and chronologically reconstructable.

capabilities.title: Change Intent Ledger
capabilities.purpose: Record what an agent intends to change, why, expected effects, and rollback strategy before execution.
capabilities.invariant: No material change begins without a declared intent and bounded scope.

capabilities.title: Human Approval Matrix
capabilities.purpose: Map risk classes and action types to required human approvals without making every harmless action bureaucratic.
capabilities.invariant: Irreversible, cross-boundary, credential, production, and permanent-deletion actions require explicit approval.

capabilities.title: Non-Destructive Quarantine
capabilities.purpose: Replace hard deletion with an evidence-backed, reversible move into a global repository quarantine for human review.
capabilities.invariant: Automated workflows never permanently delete owned source, data, documentation, configuration, evidence, or unknown files.

capabilities.title: Repository Constitution
capabilities.purpose: Define the non-negotiable operating laws that every agent, skill, orchestration, and tool must obey before touching a project.
capabilities.invariant: No lower-level prompt, agent preference, or convenience may override the constitution.

capabilities.title: Secret and Sensitive Boundary Manager
capabilities.purpose: Prevent secrets, sensitive data, and project-private context from leaking into logs, memories, prompts, or other projects.
capabilities.invariant: Sensitive material is never copied into a broader trust zone than its source.

capabilities.title: Side-Effect Budgeter
capabilities.purpose: Declare and enforce the maximum expected writes, file moves, API calls, restarts, and resource consumption for a run.
capabilities.invariant: A task that exceeds its side-effect budget pauses instead of quietly widening its blast radius.

capabilities.title: Why and Evidence Gate
capabilities.purpose: Force every material recommendation or change to state why it is needed and what evidence supports it.
capabilities.invariant: An agent may not make a consequential change solely because it appears cleaner, newer, or more elegant.

capabilities.title: Branch and Worktree Manager
capabilities.purpose: Give parallel agents isolated Git work surfaces while preserving a clean integration path.
capabilities.invariant: Concurrent agents do not edit the same working tree unless explicitly coordinated.

capabilities.title: Checkpoint and Resume Manager
capabilities.purpose: Capture enough project and agent state to safely pause work and resume without relying on conversational memory.
capabilities.invariant: A resumable checkpoint contains evidence of completed work, open risks, exact repo state, and next actions.

capabilities.title: Concurrency and Lock Manager
capabilities.purpose: Prevent conflicting changes to files, schemas, migrations, environments, and shared resources across agents.
capabilities.invariant: A lock has an owner, scope, reason, expiry, and recovery rule.

capabilities.title: Cross-Project Transfer Broker
capabilities.purpose: Move reusable knowledge or artifacts between projects only through explicit, sanitized, reviewable transfer packages.
capabilities.invariant: Direct project-to-project context reads and writes are prohibited.

capabilities.title: Multi-Repository Project Tracker
capabilities.purpose: Represent projects that span multiple repositories while preserving repository-specific roots and responsibilities.
capabilities.invariant: A project may contain many repos, but each repo has a declared role and independent change boundary.

capabilities.title: Project Closure and Autopsy
capabilities.purpose: Close a project with a validated final state and extract reusable lessons, failures, capabilities, and unresolved risks.
capabilities.invariant: Closure produces a durable knowledge package rather than merely abandoning the repo.

capabilities.title: Project Dormancy and Archive Manager
capabilities.purpose: Pause inactive projects safely while preserving their state, knowledge, dependencies, and restart path.
capabilities.invariant: Dormant does not mean deleted or forgotten.

capabilities.title: Project Health Scorecard
capabilities.purpose: Summarize project status across build, tests, security, docs, drift, agent work, risks, and operational readiness.
capabilities.invariant: Scores link to evidence and never hide failing critical gates behind averages.

capabilities.title: Project Registry
capabilities.purpose: Maintain authoritative records of where projects live, their identities, policies, repositories, owners, and current state.
capabilities.invariant: A filesystem path alone is never treated as project identity.

capabilities.title: Project Session Router
capabilities.purpose: Start, pause, resume, and switch agent sessions without carrying stale state between projects.
capabilities.invariant: One execution session has one active project identity.

capabilities.title: Repository Onboarding and Autodiscovery
capabilities.purpose: Inspect a new repository, identify its stack and operational surfaces, then propose a bounded onboarding plan.
capabilities.invariant: Discovery is read-only until the project is registered and approved for modification.

capabilities.title: Semantic Context Firewall
capabilities.purpose: Prevent memories, documents, embeddings, prompts, and agent state from one project bleeding into another.
capabilities.invariant: Context retrieval is default-deny outside the active project namespace and approved global policies.

capabilities.title: Shared Capability Promotion
capabilities.purpose: Promote a proven project-local pattern into a reusable global skill or library without leaking project semantics.
capabilities.invariant: Shared capabilities are generalized, sanitized, independently tested, and versioned.

capabilities.title: Workspace Bootstrap
capabilities.purpose: Create the standard projects, tracking, quarantine, shared-capability, and runtime control-plane layout.
capabilities.invariant: Project source and control-plane state remain physically and semantically separate.

capabilities.title: Workstream Dispatcher
capabilities.purpose: Break project goals into isolated workstreams and route them to agents with dependencies, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
capabilities.invariant: Agents receive bounded work packages, not vague permission to roam the repository.

capabilities.title: Agent Conflict Arbiter
capabilities.purpose: Resolve disagreements between agents about plans, facts, ownership, or changes using evidence and defined authority.
capabilities.invariant: Conflicts are surfaced; they are never settled by whichever agent writes last.

capabilities.title: Agent Factory
capabilities.purpose: Create bounded agents from reusable role, capability, tool, memory, and governance templates.
capabilities.invariant: An agent is a declared operational identity, not an untracked prompt instance.

capabilities.title: Agent Identity and Permissions
capabilities.purpose: Issue least-privilege identities and scoped capabilities to agents per project, session, and workstream.
capabilities.invariant: Agent identity, project identity, and human sponsor are always distinguishable.

capabilities.title: Agent Lease Manager
capabilities.purpose: Bind an agent to a project, workstream, worktree, tools, paths, and time window for a specific execution session.
capabilities.invariant: No agent acts without a valid, renewable, and revocable lease.

capabilities.title: Agent Performance and Health
capabilities.purpose: Measure agent accuracy, safety, completion rate, regressions, resource use, and human correction burden.
capabilities.invariant: Agent quality is judged by validated outcomes, not fluent output or activity volume.

capabilities.title: Agent Registry and Lifecycle
capabilities.purpose: Track every agent from proposal through sandbox, probation, active use, pause, retirement, or revocation.
capabilities.invariant: Only registered active agents may receive work or tool leases.

capabilities.title: Agent Retirement and Memory Handoff
capabilities.purpose: Retire an agent cleanly while preserving useful validated knowledge and revoking all operational access.
capabilities.invariant: Agent-specific noise is not promoted into durable memory merely because the agent is retired.

capabilities.title: Agent Team Composer
capabilities.purpose: Build temporary multi-agent teams with complementary roles, handoff contracts, and a single accountable coordinator.
capabilities.invariant: Every team has a clear decision authority and conflict-resolution path.

capabilities.title: Agent Template Catalog
capabilities.purpose: Maintain versioned templates for planner, implementer, reviewer, tester, researcher, diagnostician, and other agent roles.
capabilities.invariant: Templates define defaults; project manifests define bounded overrides.

capabilities.title: Duplicate Effort Detector
capabilities.purpose: Detect when agents or workstreams are independently solving the same problem or editing overlapping scopes.
capabilities.invariant: Parallelism should increase throughput, not multiply contradictory work.

capabilities.title: Model Calibration and Router
capabilities.purpose: Benchmark available models against task types and route work by capability, privacy, latency, cost, and reliability.
capabilities.invariant: Model selection is evidence-based and may differ by project and task.

capabilities.title: Adaptive Minimum-Bit Hash and Alphabetic Sharder
capabilities.purpose: Assign the smallest collision-safe addressing width needed for a local memory namespace and map prefixes into deterministic alphabetic directory buckets.
capabilities.invariant: Addressing optimization is not confused with cryptographic integrity; content integrity uses a separate strong hash.

capabilities.title: Assumption Decay
capabilities.purpose: Reduce confidence in assumptions as their evidence ages or their environment changes, then trigger re-verification.
capabilities.invariant: Unverified assumptions do not remain permanently high-confidence.

capabilities.title: Context Budget Compiler
capabilities.purpose: Compile the smallest task-specific context bundle that satisfies evidence, dependency, and policy requirements.
capabilities.invariant: Context is selected by need and authority, not by dumping the entire project history.

capabilities.title: Continuous Knowledge Compression
capabilities.purpose: Merge overlapping knowledge, preserve deltas, and reduce context size without erasing evidence or meaningful distinctions.
capabilities.invariant: Compression may reduce duplication, never provenance or historical truth.

capabilities.title: Contradiction Engine
capabilities.purpose: Detect conflicting facts, rules, decisions, measurements, and documentation before they silently coexist.
capabilities.invariant: Contradictions create explicit review states; they are not resolved by recency alone.

capabilities.title: Evidence Freshness Verifier
capabilities.purpose: Determine whether evidence is still current enough for the decision that depends on it.
capabilities.invariant: Evidence validity is contextual; age alone does not decide freshness.

capabilities.title: Knowledge Coverage
capabilities.purpose: Measure which project components, decisions, interfaces, and risks have sufficient current documentation and memory coverage.
capabilities.invariant: Coverage measures evidence-backed understanding, not raw document count.

capabilities.title: Knowledge Distillation
capabilities.purpose: Convert noisy conversations, logs, and documents into minimal factual memory objects with provenance and confidence.
capabilities.invariant: Store the smallest sufficient knowledge, not the entire surrounding conversation.

capabilities.title: Memory Provenance and Evidence
capabilities.purpose: Trace every durable memory to its source, extraction method, confidence, and subsequent revisions.
capabilities.invariant: A memory without provenance is treated as unverified context, not durable knowledge.

capabilities.title: Memory Self-Healer
capabilities.purpose: Repair broken links, duplicate notes, stale indexes, invalid hashes, and orphaned graph edges without inventing content.
capabilities.invariant: Automated repair changes structure and metadata only unless factual content is independently verified.

capabilities.title: Obsidian-Style Memory Mapper
capabilities.purpose: Store durable memories as human-readable mapped notes with typed bidirectional links and graph indexes.
capabilities.invariant: The markdown note is the inspectable source of truth; indexes are rebuildable projections.

capabilities.title: Uncertainty Registry
capabilities.purpose: Track unresolved questions, disputed facts, confidence gaps, and unknown dependencies as first-class project objects.
capabilities.invariant: Unknown is a valid state and must not be replaced by a plausible guess.

capabilities.title: Capability Gap and Skill Foundry Trigger
capabilities.purpose: Detect missing capabilities and launch a governed skill-design process only when reuse and composition cannot satisfy the need.
capabilities.invariant: The system searches, composes, and adapts before creating another skill.

capabilities.title: Capability Graph
capabilities.purpose: Represent what the system can do independently of which specific skill or model currently implements it.
capabilities.invariant: Orchestrations request capabilities; routing resolves compatible implementations.

capabilities.title: Decision Graph
capabilities.purpose: Connect architectural and operational decisions to evidence, assumptions, alternatives, implementations, and later outcomes.
capabilities.invariant: A decision is not just prose; it has dependencies and consequences that remain queryable.

capabilities.title: Drift Radar
capabilities.purpose: Compare declared architecture, documentation, memory, tests, policies, and runtime behavior to detect divergence.
capabilities.invariant: Passing tests do not prove the system still matches its declared design.

capabilities.title: Engineering Receipts
capabilities.purpose: Generate compact, durable receipts for changes, decisions, validations, deployments, and incidents.
capabilities.invariant: A receipt states what happened, why, evidence, tradeoffs, validation, and recovery path.

capabilities.title: Framework DNA Extractor
capabilities.purpose: Extract reusable architectural principles, governance, naming, testing, and operational patterns from a successful project.
capabilities.invariant: Framework DNA captures principles and contracts, not a blind copy of project-specific files.

capabilities.title: Opportunity Miner
capabilities.purpose: Identify where repeated effort, manual review, latency, or error concentration justifies a new skill, tool, or orchestration.
capabilities.invariant: Automation opportunities are prioritized by measured value and risk, not novelty.

capabilities.title: Orchestration Dependency Graph
capabilities.purpose: Map orchestrations to their skills, tools, data, policies, outputs, side effects, and downstream consumers.
capabilities.invariant: No orchestration is treated as an isolated script when other workflows depend on it.

capabilities.title: Pattern Miner
capabilities.purpose: Find recurring implementation, validation, diagnostic, and orchestration patterns across workstreams.
capabilities.invariant: Patterns are candidates until validated; repetition alone does not prove good design.

capabilities.title: Skill Evolution and Lineage
capabilities.purpose: Track skill ancestry, forks, merges, replacements, compatibility, and deprecation over time.
capabilities.invariant: Skill identity and lineage survive renames and reorganizations.

capabilities.title: Skill Health and Entropy Manager
capabilities.purpose: Detect stale, duplicated, drifting, over-broad, or unused skills and recommend merge, repair, deprecation, or quarantine.
capabilities.invariant: A large skill count is not automatically healthy; every active skill needs a current purpose and evidence.

capabilities.title: Acceptance Gate Controller
capabilities.purpose: Coordinate all required policy, test, security, outcome, documentation, and approval gates before integration or deployment.
capabilities.invariant: A gate cannot be marked passed without attached current evidence.

capabilities.title: Autonomous Benchmark Lab
capabilities.purpose: Benchmark skills, agents, models, and orchestrations for quality, latency, cost, resource use, and regression.
capabilities.invariant: Benchmarks use versioned fixtures and report uncertainty; one cherry-picked run proves nothing.

capabilities.title: Change Blast-Radius Predictor
capabilities.purpose: Predict which components, tests, data, agents, docs, and deployments may be affected by a proposed change.
capabilities.invariant: Prediction informs testing and approval; it never substitutes for validation.

capabilities.title: Chaos Architect
capabilities.purpose: Design bounded failure experiments for services, dependencies, agents, storage, networks, and corrupted inputs.
capabilities.invariant: Chaos testing never exceeds the declared sandbox, safety envelope, or recovery capacity.

capabilities.title: Interface Contract Catalog
capabilities.purpose: Catalog APIs, events, schemas, CLI commands, files, queues, and human handoffs with versioned behavioral contracts.
capabilities.invariant: Interfaces are defined by observable behavior and compatibility, not only type signatures.

capabilities.title: Outcome Contract Validator
capabilities.purpose: Verify that actions achieved the intended business and system effect, not merely that commands returned success.
capabilities.invariant: A change passes only when its declared outcome and downstream effects are correct.

capabilities.title: Regression Causality Engine
capabilities.purpose: Correlate failures with changes, environment shifts, dependency updates, and agent actions to identify likely causes.
capabilities.invariant: Correlation is reported with confidence and does not become blame without evidence.

capabilities.title: Repository Digital Twin
capabilities.purpose: Build an analyzable graph model of files, symbols, services, APIs, data, skills, agents, docs, and operational dependencies.
capabilities.invariant: The twin is a derived model for simulation and impact analysis, not a replacement for source-of-truth repositories.

capabilities.title: Reproducibility Manifest
capabilities.purpose: Capture the exact code, data, environment, models, tools, configuration, and commands needed to reproduce a result.
capabilities.invariant: Results without reproducibility metadata are treated as provisional.

capabilities.title: Rollback Rehearsal
capabilities.purpose: Prove that rollback, restore, and quarantine recovery procedures work before they are needed in an incident.
capabilities.invariant: A rollback plan is not considered valid until exercised against a representative state.

capabilities.title: Semantic Contamination Detector
capabilities.purpose: Detect project names, private assumptions, schemas, memories, or embeddings appearing in another project or shared capability.
capabilities.invariant: Cross-project similarity is not automatically evidence of contamination, but unexplained provenance is blocked.

capabilities.title: Supply-Chain Sentinel
capabilities.purpose: Track third-party packages, tools, models, containers, licenses, provenance, and vulnerability state.
capabilities.invariant: New dependencies are not trusted merely because a package manager can install them.
